stages.name: Salvage over the hazard
stages.law: objective law, measured at the newest physical sample: HELD only while the engine's step counter advances (paused or step-stalled polls show a stale chip, not a ruling); the newest crate's COM is inside the marked region x 0.54..0.70 m, -0.05..+0.05 m, and every corner of the crate box (50 x 25 x 25 m half-extents about the COM, rotated by the crate's live pose) whose x/z projects inside the pad-top footprint x 0.48..0.76 m, z -0.08..+0.08 m sits >= 4 mm above the live slab top (corners projecting outside the footprint do not count; mild tilt is legal); supports may stand on the pad — only the crate's own corners are judged here, until gap row 4 decides otherwise; the load path is the admitted contact physics only
stages.tool: Tab place mode | Enter commit | F weld | X remove | F9 save | F10 load
stages.falsifier: a crate corner resting on the hazard slab at the newest physical sample, or COM out of the region
stages.cell: HELD: crate's worst in-footprint corner 80 mm above the hazard slab, inside the marked region.
